changeSet.comment: Refactoring clients table to match Vantage OpenAPI specification

changeSet.author: alsahid
changeSet.comment: Senior Move: Multi-column GIN index for high-performance fuzzy search
changeSet.sql: -- This creates a single index across all text fields. -- This allows "Vantage Wealth" to match a client even if that string -- is partially in the name and partially in the email domain. CREATE INDEX idx_clients_fuzzy_search ON clients USING gin ((first_name || ' ' || last_name || ' ' || email || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '')) gin_trgm_ops);
